objective: Determine whether an OI-only aggregation of broad RFF and SAVE ranks improves top-five shortlist quality across the completed real-image continuous panels without using linear-probe scores at inference.
scope: Post-outcome developmental diagnostic over three completed target families and two dataset groups. It cannot serve as confirmation or authorize integration.
retrieval_rule: Take complete broad-RFF rank groups until at least ten candidates are included.

aggregation.formula: alpha * broad_ordinal_score + (1-alpha) * SAVE_ordinal_score inside the retrieval pool; candidates outside the pool retain broad order

leave_dataset_out_selection.rule: For each held-out dataset group, choose the weight with minimum mean top-five utility regret on every panel from the other group.
leave_dataset_out_selection.utkface_grouping_reason: The age and absolute-age tasks share exact images and embeddings and must never be split across weight selection and evaluation.

metrics: top-one opportunity regret and exact-best coverage

bootstrap.unit: joint replicate-seed block across all three target families

decision_rule.primary: upper95 leave-dataset-out-minus-broad top-five mean utility regret < 0
safety: all 150 method-panel rows complete and finite
held-out outcomes never influence their dataset group's selected weight
decision_rule.interpretation: A pass identifies a candidate aggregation rule for a future untouched dataset; it does not validate the selected rule on unseen data.
